# M12-S2: unauthorized_cgo names a dependency that owns a cgo wrapper. The
# standard library's own cgo (the net resolver) never blames the dependencies
# that call it: an ordinary net/http dependency builds under the default
# policy.
# RED expectation: the reverse chain search walks past the standard
# library's trampoline and reports the dependency, so the build fails with
# unauthorized_cgo.

[!cgo] skip
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd main
logos build -o $WORK/bin/stdcgo$GOEXE ./cmd
! stderr 'capabilities'
go tool nm $WORK/bin/stdcgo$GOEXE
stdout '_C2?func_getaddrinfo'
exec $WORK/bin/stdcgo$GOEXE
stdout '^ok$'

# A dependency that owns a cgo wrapper is still blamed in a binary whose
# standard library also uses cgo: the audit reaches the wrappers (it flags
# the evil dependency) yet the net dependency takes no blame.
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/stdcgoevil$GOEXE ./cmdevil
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_cgo\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/evil'' reaches ''runtime\.cgocall'''
stderr 'example\.com/evil\.Ping\(\)'
! stderr 'example\.com/ndep'

-- main/go.mod --
module example.com/nmain

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/ndep v0.0.0
	example.com/evil v0.0.0
)

replace (
	example.com/ndep => ../dep
	example.com/evil => ../evil
)

-- main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_net = "allow"
transitive_reflect = "allow"
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = ["example.com/evil/**"]

-- main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ndep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(dep.Fetch(""))
}

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/ndep

go 1.27

-- dep/dep.go --
package dep

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

//go:noinline
func Fetch(u string) string {
	if len(os.Args) > 99 {
		if resp, err := http.Get(u); err == nil {
			resp.Body.Close()
		}
	}
	return "ok"
}

-- main/cmdevil/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ndep"
	"example.com/evil"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(dep.Fetch(""))
	fmt.Println(evil.Ping())
}

-- evil/go.mod --
module example.com/evil

go 1.27

-- evil/evil.go --
package evil

/*
int fortytwo() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

//go:noinline
func Ping() int {
	return int(C.fortytwo())
}
